claim: The café opens at 8 am on weekdays.
text: Opening hours: Monday to Friday 8:00–18:00, weekends 10:00–16:00.

claim: The laptop battery lasts a full working day.
text: In our tests the battery ran for 4 hours of video playback before the laptop shut down.

claim: The museum is free for children.
text: Tickets cost 12 € for adults and 6 € for students. Children under 7 enter free.

claim: The train to Lyon was cancelled.
text: Because of the strike, all trains to Lyon are cancelled until Thursday.

claim: The new phone has a headphone jack.
text: There is no 3.5 mm port, but a USB-C to 3.5 mm adapter comes in the box.

claim: The hotel has a swimming pool.
text: Guests enjoy free Wi-Fi, a fitness room and breakfast served until 11.
